The clinic: full build, rough placeholder art

The whole pipeline: waiting room, diagnosis, the pharmacy belt, heal, send-off. Words are English placeholders until the family's recordings go in; the art is throwaway.

The clinicPlay a clinic morning (the first ever is one tiny patient). Saves your progress. Clinic lab index oldEvery stage × variant × level, and every healing game in the pipeline. Clinic lab barPick a morning, a patient, one stage or one healing game.

Clinic stages

1 Waiting roomW1–W4 (W3 is spoken). 2 DiagnosisD1, D1b, D2, D3, with the face magnifier. 3 Pharmacy beltTap what the doctor needs; the handover. 4 HealMounts one healing game (the scrape here). 5 Send-offE1–E4 (E3 and E4 are spoken). One patientAll five stages, then the end-of-round screen.

Behind the scenes

Shared pieces oldSpeech, the "which one?" chooser, relations, stars, overlays. ConversationsThe nine MVP exchanges: play each one, boy/girl voice, register, placeholder flags; simulate the first launch, Cook and the clinic. Family voice clipsMum's and Zafar's words from the recordings (Section B, then Round 3): play each one, tick the good ones. Speaking moments ask for the microphone; if you say no, word pills appear instead. Nothing you say leaves the device.
